search_helper_source: examples/nnue_tournament_bench.rs at the recorded source revisions
method: One search at a time in two persistent processes, randomized case order, exactly alternating baseline/candidate order per case/repetition; A/A is a separate baseline/baseline control. Model loading and replay outside search timers. Mixed-model requests can reset thread-local NNUE row/delta caches; this is a repeated mixed-corpus workload, not a measurement of a continuously warm single-model cache. No concurrent compiler, training or test jobs during recorded timings. CPU primary; wall secondary. Exact signature/depth/abort checks on every request. RSS is sampled after responses; HWM includes loading/replay/warmups, not isolated search allocations.
